refund-enterprise.answer: No. The refund policy does not apply to enterprise contracts. Enterprise customers raise a billing dispute with their account manager instead.

standard-refund-window.answer: Standard customers can request a refund within 30 days of delivery.

dock-door-red-light.answer: No. Never open a dock door showing a red light.

stale-hotel-limit.answer: Lodging is reimbursed up to $210 per night before taxes in most cities, and up to $290 in high-cost cities.

card-data-retention.answer: Larkspur keeps only the last four digits and the expiry month of a card, for 90 days after the last order.

same-day-cutoff.answer: In-stock orders placed before 2 p.m. Central time on a business day ship the same day.

vague-outage.answer: For a Portal outage outside business hours, call the Duty Desk at extension 4410 to page the on-call engineer.

payment-methods.answer: Company credit cards, purchase orders for approved accounts, bank transfer for invoices over $2,000, and digital wallets for card-paying customers.

kestrel-purchase-approver.answer: Tomasz Rehnquist, Director of Warehouse Technology, approves purchases for the Fulfillment Systems team, which owns the Kestrel K2 integration.

k2-volume-price.answer: A Kestrel K2 handheld scanner costs $410 per unit when you order 50 or more.

dock-sensor-warranty.answer: The DS-100 dock door sensor has a three-year warranty from the date of shipment.

customer-success-lead.answer: Ingrid Vasquez-Lund leads the Customer Success team.
